name: pane
title: Pane
summary: One cell of a workspace: a mono label header with its tools, over its content.
use: To divide a tool into regions people work in side by side: a browser, a viewer, an inspector, a timeline.
anatomy: Header: optional icon, mono label, optional subtitle, trailing tools

options.name: title
options.description: One or two words, shown as a mono label.

options.name: accessories
options.description: The pane's own tools, at the trailing end.

options.name: title view
options.description: Swift: the header's title slot, so a workspace can make the title the handle that drags the pane.

rules: Panes have no corners, fill of their own or shadow. The workspace divides them with one hairline and no gap.
The header label is the pane's name in a mono label; never a title.
Tools in the header are ghost icon buttons; an open state uses surface, never the accent.
Only the title is a drag handle; the header's tools never start a drag.
accessibility: The pane is a labelled group named by its title.
